apiKey.title: Post Engineer API key
apiKey.description: Create one at https://post-engineer.com/api-keys (starts with pe_live_). Without a key the run is a dry run: it validates the input and shows the request it would send, with nothing generated, published or charged. With a key, generating a video spends tokens from that account.

hook.title: Hook
hook.description: Opening line. Hook, body and CTA together must be 60 to 200 words; the script is validated before any token is spent.
hook.prefill: Most people scroll past your posts in under two seconds.

body.title: Body
body.prefill: Short vertical videos stop the scroll because they show a face, a clear idea and movement in the first moments. You do not need a camera, a studio or an editor to make them every day. Write the idea once as a hook, a body and a call to action, and let an AI persona present it for you, with captions and b-roll that match what you say.

cta.title: Call to action
cta.prefill: Follow for one practical tip like this every day.

providers.title: Publish to
providers.description: One or more of: youtube, instagram, linkedin, bluesky, threads. Connect the accounts first at https://post-engineer.com.

personaId.title: Persona ID
personaId.description: AI persona that presents the video (lip-sync on the hook). Leave empty for a faceless video.

voiceId.title: Voice ID
voiceId.description: Narration voice: an id from GET /api/persona/voices. Required without a persona; with a persona it overrides the persona's voice.

faceless.title: Faceless video
faceless.description: No face on screen, only b-roll or animated svg (cheapest). Defaults to true when no persona is set.

facelessMaterial.title: Faceless material
facelessMaterial.description: What fills a faceless video: stock b-roll or animated svg scenes.

fullLipsync.title: Full lip-sync
fullLipsync.description: The persona talks for the whole video instead of only the hook (most expensive). Needs a persona; not with faceless.

accounts.title: Account IDs per provider
accounts.description: Optional, e.g. {"youtube": ["<account id>"]}. Defaults to the persona's publishing accounts.

mode.title: When to publish
mode.description: asap publishes as soon as the video is ready; scheduled uses the schedule below.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Only for mode scheduled: {"startAt": "2026-12-01T09:00:00Z", "times": ["18:00"], "timezone": "America/Sao_Paulo"}. startAt is an ISO datetime; slots must be 3 hours to 30 days ahead.

waitForCompletion.title: Wait for the video
waitForCompletion.description: Keep the run open until the video is generated (or fails) and return its status.

timeoutMinutes.title: Wait timeout (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: How long to wait for the video before returning status timeout.

apiUrl.title: API base URL
apiUrl.description: Only for self-hosted Post Engineer. Must be https (http is allowed only for localhost).
